description: Returns Attestd-covered products for CVE checks. With an API key, returns live data from GET /v1/products (CVE infrastructure slugs plus monitored supply chain packages). Without a key, returns the static bundled infrastructure list. PyPI and npm packages also work with check_package_vulnerability even when absent from this list.
name: list_covered_products

count.description: Number of covered infrastructure products (static source only).

cveProducts.description: CVE infrastructure products from GET /v1/products (live source only).

products.description: Covered CVE infrastructure products (static source only).

source.description: static when no API key is provided; live when fetched from GET /v1/products.

supplyChainPackages.description: Monitored PyPI and npm packages from GET /v1/products (live source only).

total.description: Total covered CVE products plus supply chain packages (live source only).
